content: Game Accessibility Guidelines' Basic recommendations include simple clear language, readable default text, progress prompts at user's pace, avoid flicker, high contrast, no essential color-only information, and large, spaced touch controls; its intermediate recommendations include visual alternatives for audio cues, practice without failure, contextual help, indicate interactivity, and option to hide background movement. Treat as valuable checklist, not binding standard. Medium confidence, cross-referenced with current WCAG principles.
